# Cal/OSHA Wildfire Smoke Safety and Emergency Training

> Introductory online course on protecting outdoor and partially outdoor workers in California from wildfire smoke, based on Cal/OSHA Title 8, Section 5141.1 (Protection from Wildfire Smoke). Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Regulation: Cal/OSHA Title 8 §5141.1; respirator program requirements under Title 8 §5144 when use is mandatory
- Required: §5141.1 requires employers to train employees on wildfire smoke hazards, protective measures and emergency procedures (Appendix B)
- Respirators: typically mandatory when AQI exceeds 500, with fit-testing and medical evaluation under §5144
- Duration: about 1 hour 10 minutes; 9 lessons plus final exam
- Credits: 0.1 CEU
- Price: $47.99 per person online or SCORM; bulk pricing from 2 seats; virtual instructor-led $199/person and in-person $750/person (minimum 10)
- Language: English only
- Certificate: instant PDF on passing, valid 12 months
- Renewal: no Cal/OSHA expiration; retrain when duties, locations or risks change; annual spring refresher (April–May) recommended before peak fire season

## Who it is for
Outdoor and partially outdoor workers and supervisors in construction, agriculture, utilities and public works, landscaping and grounds, transportation and warehousing, plus EHS, compliance and HR staff.

## Lessons
1. Introduction to Wildfire Smoke
2. Cal/OSHA Regulation Overview (§5141.1)
3. Health and Safety Risks
4. Air Quality and Exposure Monitoring (AQI, PM2.5)
5. Exposure Control Strategies
6. Respiratory Protection and PPE
7. Communication and Employee Information
8. Emergency Planning and Response
9. Additional Resources and Best Practices
